summary: Microwave-based technology used for body-contouring, cellulite and firmness concerns.
leadAnswer: Microwave Contouring uses microwave-based energy, delivered at Kaiteki through the Onda platform, to address localised fat, cellulite appearance and skin firmness. Which areas are treatable, and whether any of yours are, is settled by examining the area rather than by naming the concern.
seoDescription: Onda microwave contouring in Malaysia for localised fat, cellulite appearance and firmness. Book a free consultation with a Kaiteki doctor to check suitability.
bringToConsult: Mention every device or implant at consultation.

avoidIf.body: which your doctor goes through with you.

sessionSteps.title: Consultation and assessment
sessionSteps.body: Your first visit is a consultation, not a treatment. The doctor examines the area, decides whether it is treatable, and chooses between Onda for Body and Onda for Face.

sessionSteps.title: The treatment
sessionSteps.body: After the area is examined, a handpiece is moved over it to deliver the energy while the surface is cooled. Most people describe a warming sensation.

bands.title: Straight afterwards
bands.body: Temporary warmth, redness or mild tenderness over the treated area can occur and typically settles.

afterSession.aftercare: Most people return to usual activities. The doctor gives aftercare guidance specific to you.

risks.intro: Like any energy-based treatment, it carries risks, which are explained before a course is booked.
risks.common: Redness, swelling, warmth or tenderness in the treated area.
risks.lessCommon: The energy is thermal, so the risk that matters is overheating one spot. It is managed by keeping the handpiece moving and by treating within what the doctor judges the tissue can take.
risks.pigmentNote: Microwave energy heats tissue beneath a cooled surface rather than targeting pigment, so it does not rely on colour contrast the way a laser does.
cannotDo: It is not a weight-loss treatment: it treats localised areas, not overall body weight.
Not every area is treatable. That is settled by examining it, not by naming the concern.
It is not a single-session treatment. A course is common, and a body area generally takes more sessions than a facial one.
risks.disclose: Tell your doctor about every implant or medical device, and your full medical history.

costFactors.intro: Sessions and cost depend on the areas treated and how you respond. A facial area and a body area take very different amounts of time on the handpiece, so cost follows the areas agreed at consultation.
factors: The area being treated, body or face.
How many sessions the course needs, which depends on your response.

sections.heading: What is Microwave Contouring?
body: Microwave Contouring is a category of non-invasive body- and face-contouring technology that uses microwave-based energy to act on tissue beneath the skin's surface. At Kaiteki this is delivered using the Onda platform, which the manufacturer refers to as Coolwaves® technology.

It is used on localised fat on areas such as the abdomen, flanks, thighs and arms, on the dimpled appearance of cellulite, and on skin firmness, including the face and jawline. It is not a weight-loss treatment: it treats localised areas, not overall body weight.

sections.heading: How can microwave energy reach fat without burning the skin?
body: Microwave energy is delivered beneath the skin's surface while built-in cooling helps keep the surface protected during treatment. The energy is intended to act on the targeted tissue, for example localised fat cells or the fibrous bands associated with cellulite, and may also prompt a gradual collagen-remodelling response supporting firmness.

faqs.q: What device is used at Kaiteki?
faqs.a: The Onda platform, which its manufacturer calls Coolwaves® technology.

faqs.q: Is it painful, and is there downtime?
faqs.a: Built-in cooling protects the surface, and most people describe a warming sensation. Downtime is usually limited.

faqs.q: How many sessions will I need?
faqs.a: A course of several sessions spaced a few weeks apart is common. A body area generally takes more sessions than a facial one, simply because there is more of it.
No. It addresses localised areas of fat and skin firmness, not overall body weight, and it is not a substitute for weight management.

faqs.q: What is the difference between Onda and Onda Pro?
faqs.a: Onda Pro is DEKA's newer generation of Onda. Both use the same Coolwaves® microwave technology, and Onda Pro has dedicated handpieces for the face and the body. Kaiteki has both, and the doctor chooses the device for the area being treated.
